**Lesson (one line, in library format)**
- **<pattern>** — <why it matters> (source: <skill type, YYYY-MM-DD>, evidence: <what happened>)

**Evidence**
What happened in your forge(s) that showed this? How many times have you seen it?

**Example**
A short, anonymized before/after or scenario.

**Checklist**
- [ ] No names, companies, clients, locations, contact details, or private links
- [ ] Generalizes beyond one skill or industry
- [ ] States a reason, not just a rule
